newsitem.title: GREECE: QUAKE SHAKES RHODES BUT NO REPORTS OF DAMAGE.
newsitem.headline: QUAKE SHAKES RHODES BUT NO REPORTS OF DAMAGE.

text.p: An earthquake shook the Aegean holiday island of Rhodes at 4.45 a.m. (0145 GMT) but there were no reports of injury or damage, the Athens Observatory said on Friday.
The earthquake registered 4.8 on the Richter scale. Its epicentre was 440 km southeast of Athens, in the sea bed 20 km east of Rhodes.
The Observatory said the quake came almost 12 hours after a similar tremor from the same epicentre, registering 4.5 on the Richter scale.
A seismologist at the Observatory said seismic activity beginning with small tremors rarely resulted in a major quake. --Maria Petrakis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
